build_tfds_dataset_builder: build a TensorFlow Dataset builder function from a TFDS dataset name with split, shuffle, and slicing support
combine_indices: combine outer and inner start/end slice indices into a single combined start and end tuple
create_tfds_metadata: create a TFDSMetadata named tuple with the number of examples for a given dataset split
lock_dataset_builder: acquire a per-dataset process-level mutex to safely call tfds download_and_prepare concurrently
slice_str: generate a TFDS split slice string like train[0:100] from a split name and optional start and end indices
